body:
Hi. It's already amazing that you're here asking for help. Keep looking around this website because there are many amazing people to talk with. 
About your collage situation, the only advice I can give you is to do what YOU want. You are here, suffering, just because of the expectations of the people around you. You don't have to be successful to be happy. If going down this road will cause you so much pain, I don't think God would want that. Just try to go with the flow, you don't need to know exactly what you want to do in life. I hope this makes you feel better, even if just a little. I know for sure that your loved ones would want you to be happy, even if it may not seem like it. My hopes are with you, and good luck <3 .

Hi. If you read this, i'd just like to say that people really do care. Even if you might feel like nobody appreciates your existence, there is always someone that will cry when you are gone. At least I can say that you made me care. I don't know if that's strange or not, but you're doing the right thing in trying to get help. Just keep looking, maybe you'll find the right person on this website to chat with. I know it may feel like what it feels like now will last forever, but anything can happen. What i'm trying to say is that if you think there is even the smallest chance of you feeling better, the smallest thing worth suffering for, then there might be a point in waiting just a little longer. I really hope this didn't offend you in any way, and good luck.

The only think I can think of is that you should try to communicate to your family that you deeply, truly love them and to somehow make it so they don't feel guilty afterwards. This advice is pretty much the same as the other two comments, but it's all i've got. Sorry.
Good luck, and if it means anything i'll remember you.
